developer.title: Contribute to the code.
developer.lead: ONIR CMS is open source. You can fix, extend, document or simply report what is blocking. Contributions are reviewed and merged in small steps.
developer.note: Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, web-component templates.

cards.title: Code
cards.text: Targeted issues, code review, tests. Start with a small fix or a well-scoped improvement.

cards.title: Create a theme
cards.text: A visual template, a journey, a component: the marketplace welcomes useful, documented themes.

cards.title: Document and test
cards.text: Field feedback, a reproducible bug or a missing documentation page are worth as much as a PR.
